        xs = [p[0] for p in pts]
        ys = [p[1] for p in pts]

        print(f'  {color}: ({c[0]:.1f},{c[1]:.1f}) dist={math.hypot(c[0]-overall[0], c[1]-overall[1]):.1f}')
    print()

server.shutdown()

import http.server, socketserver, threading, time, re, math
from collections import defaultdict
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
server = socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
port = server.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
time.sleep(0.3)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox'])
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1400, 'height': 800})
    page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html')
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

    # Check tooltip element exists with role="tooltip"
    tt = page.locator('#tooltip[role="tooltip"]')
    print('tooltip count with role:', tt.count())

    # Hover a non-ETF (AAPL)
    page.locator('text=AAPL').first.hover()
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    visible = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print('tooltip visible after non-ETF hover:', visible)

    # Get tooltip text
    tt_text = page.locator('#tooltip').inner_text() if visible else ''
    print('tooltip text:', repr(tt_text))

    # Move away
    page.locator('#chart-panel').hover(position={'x': 10, 'y': 10})
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    visible = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print('tooltip visible after move away:', visible)

    # Hover an ETF (SPY)
    page.locator('text=SPY').first.hover()
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    visible = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print('tooltip visible after ETF hover:', visible)

    # Sector clustering check
    bubbles = page.locator('svg circle')
    n = bubbles.count()
    print('bubbles:', n)
    sectors = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n):
        b = bubbles.nth(i)
        box = b.bounding_box()
        if not box: continue
        cx = box['x'] + box['width']/2
        cy = box['y'] + box['height']/2
        fill = b.evaluate('node => getComputedStyle(node).fill') or b.get_attribute('fill')
        sectors[fill].append((cx, cy))
    sector_centroids = {}
    for color, pts in sectors.items():
        if len(pts) >= 5:
            avg_x = sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts)
            avg_y = sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
            sector_centroids[color] = (avg_x, avg_y)
    print('sector count:', len(sector_centroids))
    all_x = [p[0] for pts in sectors.values() for p in pts]
    all_y = [p[1] for pts in sectors.values() for p in pts]
    overall = (sum(all_x)/len(all_x), sum(all_y)/len(all_y))
    chart_box = page.locator('#bubble-chart').bounding_box()
    diag = math.hypot(chart_box['width'], chart_box['height'])
    max_dist = max(math.hypot(c[0]-overall[0], c[1]-overall[1]) for c in sector_centroids.values())
    print(f'diag={diag:.1f} max_dist={max_dist:.1f} allowed={diag*0.4:.1f}')

    # Click interaction
    page.locator('text=AMZN').first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    sel = page.locator('tr.is-selected').count()
    print('selected row count after bubble click:', sel)
    sel_bubble = page.locator('circle.bubble.is-selected').count()
    print('selected bubble count after bubble click:', sel_bubble)

    # Click row
    page.locator('#stock-table tbody tr').first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    sel = page.locator('tr.is-selected').count()
    print('selected row count after row click:', sel)

    browser.close()
server.shutdown()
EOF

from collections import defaultdict
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
server = socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
port = server.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
time.sleep(0.3)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox'])
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1400, 'height': 800})
    page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html')
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

    # Check tooltip element exists with role="tooltip"
    tt = page.locator('#tooltip[role="tooltip"]')
    print('tooltip count with role:', tt.count())

    # Hover a non-ETF (AAPL)
    page.locator('text=AAPL').first.hover()
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    visible = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print('tooltip visible after non-ETF hover:', visible)

    # Get tooltip text
    tt_text = page.locator('#tooltip').inner_text() if visible else ''
    print('tooltip text:', repr(tt_text))

    # Move away
    page.locator('#chart-panel').hover(position={'x': 10, 'y': 10})
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    visible = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print('tooltip visible after move away:', visible)

    # Hover an ETF (SPY)
    page.locator('text=SPY').first.hover()
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    visible = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print('tooltip visible after ETF hover:', visible)

    # Sector clustering check
    bubbles = page.locator('svg circle')
    n = bubbles.count()
    print('bubbles:', n)
    sectors = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n):
        b = bubbles.nth(i)
        box = b.bounding_box()
        if not box: continue
        cx = box['x'] + box['width']/2
        cy = box['y'] + box['height']/2
        fill = b.evaluate('node => getComputedStyle(node).fill') or b.get_attribute('fill')
        sectors[fill].append((cx, cy))
    sector_centroids = {}
    for color, pts in sectors.items():
        if len(pts) >= 5:
            avg_x = sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts)
            avg_y = sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
            sector_centroids[color] = (avg_x, avg_y)
    print('sector count:', len(sector_centroids))
    all_x = [p[0] for pts in sectors.values() for p in pts]
    all_y = [p[1] for pts in sectors.values() for p in pts]
    overall = (sum(all_x)/len(all_x), sum(all_y)/len(all_y))
    chart_box = page.locator('#bubble-chart').bounding_box()
    diag = math.hypot(chart_box['width'], chart_box['height'])
    max_dist = max(math.hypot(c[0]-overall[0], c[1]-overall[1]) for c in sector_centroids.values())
    print(f'diag={diag:.1f} max_dist={max_dist:.1f} allowed={diag*0.4:.1f}')

    page.locator('text=AMZN').first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    sel = page.locator('tr.is-selected').count()
    print('selected row count after bubble click:', sel)
    sel_bubble = page.locator('circle.bubble.is-selected').count()
    print('selected bubble count after bubble click:', sel_bubble)

    # Click row
    page.locator('#stock-table tbody tr').first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    sel = page.locator('tr.is-selected').count()
    print('selected row count after row click:', sel)

    browser.close()
server.shutdown()

import http.server, socketserver, threading, time, re, math
from collections import defaultdict
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
server = socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
port = server.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
time.sleep(0.3)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox'])
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 800})
    page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html')
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

    print('=== TOOLTIP TEST ===')
    etf_tickers = ['SPY', 'VOO', 'QQQ', 'GLD', 'XLF', 'VWO', 'XLU', 'XLV', 'VEA', 'VTV']
    # Try one ETF
    page.locator('text=SPY').first.hover(force=True)
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    etf_tooltip = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print(f'ETF (SPY) tooltip visible: {etf_tooltip} (expect 0)')

    page.mouse.move(0, 0)
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)

    # Try non-ETF
    page.locator('text=AAPL').first.hover(force=True)
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    non_etf_tooltip = page.locator('#tooltip.visible').count()
    print(f'Non-ETF (AAPL) tooltip visible: {non_etf_tooltip} (expect 1)')
    tt_text = page.locator('#tooltip').inner_text()
    print(f'  text: {repr(tt_text)}')

    print('\n=== CLUSTERING TEST ===')
    bubbles = page.locator('svg circle')
    n = bubbles.count()
    sectors = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n):
        b = bubbles.nth(i)
        box = b.bounding_box()
        if not box: continue
        cx = box['x'] + box['width']/2
        cy = box['y'] + box['height']/2
        fill = b.evaluate('node => getComputedStyle(node).fill') or b.get_attribute('fill')
        sectors[fill].append((cx, cy))
    sector_colors = {c: ps for c, ps in sectors.items() if len(ps) >= 5}
    sector_centroids = {c: (sum(p[0] for p in ps)/len(ps), sum(p[1] for p in ps)/len(ps))
                        for c, ps in sector_colors.items()}
    all_positions = [pos for ps in sector_colors.values() for pos in ps]
    overall = (sum(p[0] for p in all_positions)/len(all_positions),
               sum(p[1] for p in all_positions)/len(all_positions))
    chart_box = page.locator('#bubble-chart').bounding_box()
    diag = math.hypot(chart_box['width'], chart_box['height'])
    max_dist = max(math.hypot(c[0]-overall[0], c[1]-overall[1]) for c in sector_centroids.values())
    print(f'sector colors with >=5 bubbles: {len(sector_colors)} (expect 5)')
    print(f'max centroid distance: {max_dist:.1f}, allowed: {diag*0.4:.1f}')
    print('CLUSTERING:', 'PASS' if max_dist <= diag*0.4 and len(sector_colors) == 5 else 'FAIL')

    print('\n=== INTERACTION TEST ===')
    # Click bubble
    page.locator('text=AMZN').first.click(force=True)
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    print(f'click AMZN bubble -> rows selected: {page.locator("tr.is-selected").count()} bubbles: {page.locator("circle.bubble.is-selected").count()}')

    # Click row
    page.locator('tr[data-ticker="NVDA"]').click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    print(f'click NVDA row -> rows selected: {page.locator("tr.is-selected").count()} bubbles: {page.locator("circle.bubble.is-selected").count()}')

    browser.close()
server.shutdown()
EOF
